summary: Vigo Tower Site in Ross County, OH, at 1,060 ft, registered 2014 and listed as gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by the register; no source describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Added to the FFLOS register September 3, 2014; nominated by Mark

evidence.supports: marked as gone, registry number US 1576, OH 22
evidence.quote: Vigo Ross 39.24277 -82.80355 Tower Gone FFLOS US 1576, OH 22

evidence.supports: Ohio Department of Natural Resources as agency (page misspells it)
Vigo is an unincorporated community in Ross County
evidence.quote: Vigo is an unincorporated community in Ross County, in the U.S. state of Ohio.
A post office called Vigo was in operation from 1858 until 1933.

evidence.supports: railroad station, hotel, church, brick plant, country stores
evidence.quote: Besides post office, Vigo had a railroad station, hotel, church, brick plant, and several country stores.

corrections.why: Misspelling carried over from the transcribed list; the Twin Creek register and listing spell the agency correctly

sources.title: Vigo Tower Site
sources.publisher: Former Fire Lookout Sites, Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: The register gives only location, elevation, registration date and gone status. Two searches found no build date, height, staffing, fire history or present-site description. The agency comes from one transcribed list that misspells the name; the story uses the correct spelling and the correction is proposed for review. The community history is from Wikipedia and describes the community, not the tower.
